title: Save Punjab...
description:
Across many parts of India, especially tribal and economically weaker regions, Christianity is growing rapidly. But this rise isn’t just about faith—it’s tangled with conversion allegations, foreign funding, social pressure, and welfare dependency.

In this video, we break down the uncomfortable questions: Are conversions happening freely, or are poverty, fear, and inducements playing a role? Why are governments either silent or politically selective on the issue? And how does this impact India’s social fabric, demographics, and internal stability?

This is not an attack on any religion—but a critical look at power, influence, and accountability. Watch till the end before forming an opinion.
